West Virginia Grandpa and Grandson Go Fishing. They Find an Alligator. In November.

A 38-inch gator turned up in a chilly creek off the New River, and Florida would like to know who gave out its address.

On Saturday, Nov. 21, a man and his grandson fishing in Mill Creek, a tributary of the New River in Fayette County, West Virginia, found a 38-inch juvenile American alligator. The West Virginia Division of Natural Resources confirmed it and said it had gotten a tip about a week earlier that someone turned a gator loose in a pond nearby. West Liberty University took custody and will house it temporarily while officials look for a permanent home.
